source: Microscope
target: 显微镜

source: Twenty-four Years Earlier...
target: 二十四年前……

source: &122 Wow, looks like Vargas pulled together quite a team.
target: &122 哇，看来瓦尔加斯组了个不同寻常的团队。

source: &28 Dr Regis?
target: &28 里吉斯博士？

source: &29 Hey, Dr Regis!
target: &29 嘿，里吉斯博士！

source: &55 You CAN'T withdraw the embryo now!
target: &55 现在不能把胚胎撤走！

source: &56 We're finished without it!
target: &56 没有它，我们就完了！

source: &31 What part of 'no' wasn't clear, Baxter?
target: &31 我说“不”，有哪个字你听不懂，巴克斯特？

source: &32 We've decided not to use our embryos in the project.
target: &32 我们已经决定，不把自己的胚胎用于这个项目。

source: &33 We'll find another way to do it.
target: &33 我们会找到别的办法。

source: &57 You don't know what's at stake! Our reputations, our whole CAREERS could be made or broken by this!
target: &57 你不知道这意味着什么！我们的声誉，整个事业，都可能成败在此！

source: &124 Dr Baxter, we've made our decision.
target: &124 巴克斯特博士，我们已经决定了。

source: &58 He's poisoned you against us!
target: &58 他挑拨你，让你反对我们！

source: &59 Don't let his antiquated morals stand in the way of what we can achieve here!
target: &59 别让他那些过时的道德观，挡住我们在这里取得成就！

source: &125 Thanks to Charlie, I've seen things from a more...holistic perspective.
target: &125 多亏查理，我才从更……全面的角度看待这件事。

source: &126 There's more to life than the project.
target: &126 人生不只有这个项目。

source: &60 Bah!
&34 Thanks, Vicky.
target: &34 谢谢，维琪。

source: &127 Thank *you*, Charlie.
target: &127 该谢谢*你*，查理。

source: &128 We're starting our lives together, and that's what's most important to me.
target: &128 我们要一起开始新生活，对我来说，这才最重要。

source: &129 Aahh!
&130 Adam! What are you doing!?
target: &130 亚当！你在干什么！？

source: &61 Do you know what will happen when this project fails?
target: &61 你知道，这个项目失败后会怎么样吗？

source: &62 There's nowhere left to go for me after this.
target: &62 从此我就无处可去了。

source: &63 My career is in ruins, I've no future without this project...
target: &63 我的事业已经毁了，没有这个项目，我就没有未来……

source: &64 Do you see, Dr Regis? You have ended me!
target: &64 明白了吗，里吉斯博士？你毁了我！

source: &65 ...YOU...have ended...ME.
&2 Nina, I did not know you were still here.
target: &2 妮娜，没想到你还在这里。

source: &30 Nobody else is doing any work.
target: &30 其他人都没在干活。

source: &31 It looks like it's up to me to salvage this project.
target: &31 看来，只能靠我挽救这个项目了。

source: &3 Don't get me wrong, I appreciate your attitude.
target: &3 别误会，我很欣赏你的态度。

source: &4 But we have lost half of our team in one fell swoop - poor Viksha...
target: &4 可一下子，我们就失去了半个团队。可怜的维克莎……

source: &5 I cannot say that I blame Charlie for removing the embryos from the project, after that.
target: &5 发生了那种事，查理撤回胚胎，我也不能怪他。

source: &32 Mhm. Embryos.
&6 ...I know that look, Nina.
target: &6 ……我认得这个眼神，妮娜。

source: &7 There is something that you are hiding.
target: &7 你有什么事瞒着我。

source: &33 Maybe.
target: &33 也许吧。

source: &8 My God...this data...you...
target: &8 天哪……这些数据……你……

source: &34 Here's the thing about embryos - while they're at the 6 to 8 cell stage, they're *very* easy to split.
target: &34 胚胎有个特点：在6到8细胞阶段，*很*容易分割。

source: &35 It's been the basis of cloning for a century. It's how twins are made.
target: &35 一个世纪以来，这都是克隆的基础。双胞胎也是这么来的。

source: &9 You...duplicated Viksha and Charlie's embryo?
target: &9 你……复制了维克莎和查理的胚胎？

source: &36 Mhm. He's happy he's got his embryo back.
target: &36 嗯。他拿回了自己的胚胎，很高兴。

source: &37 I'm happy that I've got another three full embryos to continue the project.
target: &37 我也很高兴，因为我还有三个完整胚胎，可以继续这个项目。

source: &10 I'm not sure what to say...
target: &10 我不知道该说什么……

source: &38 Say 'thanks' to me, and say nothing to Charlie.
target: &38 对我说“谢谢”，对查理什么也别说。

source: &39 When Central is born, he'll assume we found another solution.
target: &39 等中枢诞生，他会以为我们找到了别的办法。

source: &40 This can just be our little secret...
target: &40 这就算我们之间的小秘密吧……

source: &11 Your attention please, ladies and gentlemen.
target: &11 女士们，先生们，请注意。

source: &12 As you look around, you will see some of the finest scientific minds of this generation.
target: &12 看看周围，你们会发现，同代最出色的一些科学人才就坐在这里。

source: &13 These minds have, at their disposal, the most cutting-edge tools available to humankind.
target: &13 这些人才手中，掌握着人类最尖端的工具。

source: &14 Newton has decided, like an increasing number of cities, to invest in AI management.
target: &14 和越来越多的城市一样，牛顿市决定投资人工智能管理。

source: &15 But they want no mere computer to run traffic patterns and coordinate electricity grids.
target: &15 可他们要的，不只是一台指挥交通、协调电网的计算机。

source: &16 They have asked me for something infinitely more advanced, they have asked me for the *future*.
target: &16 他们要求我提供更加先进、远超以往的东西。他们要的是*未来*。

source: &17 I have selected you for this venture, because I believe that together, we can make this future.
target: &17 我选择你们参与这项事业，因为我相信，只要携手，我们就能创造这个未来。

source: &18 Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the Central project.
target: &18 女士们，先生们，欢迎加入中枢项目。

source: &494 An optical microscope. Might not be cutting-edge, but sometimes it's just the right tool for the job.
target: &494 一台光学显微镜。也许不算最先进，但有时，最适合的工具就是它。

source: &131 It's empty.
&132 I guess that's not surprising, the project hasn't started yet.
target: &132 倒也不奇怪，项目还没开始。

source: &133 Looks like the gengineered nerve tissue is as robust as we'd hoped.
target: &133 看来，经过基因改造的神经组织，跟我们期待的一样结实耐用。

source: &134 Self-maintenance, that's the big benefit of organic hardware.
target: &134 能自我维护，这就是有机硬件最大的优势。
